research_question: Can the same completed session failed-auction and acceptance logic applied symmetrically to BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP create enough independent opportunities without re-admitting the failed broad SCDAM FAR selector?

hypothesis.pattern_detector: The frozen Candidate 12 I7 session auction is instantiated once per allowed market with identical dimensionless logic. Only the exchange-native price increment differs.
hypothesis.trading_scenario: A completed local session plan must pass the frozen four-market price-discovery session semantic gate before global arbitration.
hypothesis.module_isolation: SCDAM detectors remain observable but every core trade plan is explicitly rejected. This experiment measures session-auction alpha and frequency alone.
hypothesis.portfolio: All approved plans compete in one GlobalCandidateMutex and use the unchanged exact current-NAV 3% planned-loss sizer through NautilusTrader.
hypothesis.parameter_policy: No threshold is fitted to D01-D04. These exposed intervals are mechanism and frequency diagnostics only.

selection.method: Four already-exposed Candidate 14 quarterly intervals spanning 2022-2025 and containing meaningful market activity. They are development-only and permanently ineligible for claims.

claim_rules: D01-D04 are exposed development intervals and can never support a success claim.
A promising result must be expanded to additional exposed development intervals before any freeze.
Only after logic freeze may deterministic untouched intervals be reserved for independent validation.
A failed result must be diagnosed by scenario and market state; thresholds may not be adjusted merely to recover backtest trades.
